articles.title: Activision Confirms Brand New Call of Duty Subfranchise Is in the Works, Leading to Rampant Fan Speculation
articles.summary: Activision is actively developing a new Call of Duty subfranchise, suggesting it is ready to move on from Black Ops and Modern Warfare for the time being.
articles.body:
Activision is actively developing a new Call of Duty subfranchise, suggesting it is ready to move on from Black Ops and Modern Warfare for the time being.

In a new interview with The Game Business , Activision's Chief Marketing Officer, Tyler Bahl, confirmed that one of its studios is developing a new Call of Duty subfranchise. Although Bahl didn't state which studio is making it or when it would release, it is widely believed this will be the next game from Sledgehammer Games, expected to release next year. He also noted that Modern Warfare 4 will conclude the story that Infinity Ward has been telling since 2019, but suggested that universe could continue in the future with certain characters.

However, Activision believes the path forward for Call of Duty is less about leaning on legacy franchises and familiar faces, and more about innovation.

“Where we go with future games, we have to innovate," said Bahl. "What we heard from the audience is they want new or better or different. The landscape is changing right under our feet. You’re seeing new games being built overnight, and you’re seeing tastes change and how people want to play.”

These comments have led to all kinds of speculation about where the next Call of Duty game will go. Will they try to go into the future? The far-flung past? What kind of mechanic can they introduce to make it feel fresh without changing things up too much? Well, a rumor from Call of Duty leaker TheGhostofHope in 2025 may provide some insight, assuming it pans out.

The rumor suggests that Sledgehammer's next game will have a focus on martial arts, with karate kicks and karate chops. It's possible that Sledgehammer is trying to lean into John Wick's gun-fu combat, which mixes satisfying gunplay with fluid, flashy close-quarters combat. That seems more doable for a third-person game with a heavy emphasis on animations, but a first-person, fast-paced, competitive game may have a harder time implementing that kind of gameplay. If it works out, it could be really compelling, though.

Interestingly enough, Sledgehammer Games really began its tenure as a Call of Duty team by trying to innovate. The studio was built with the expectation that it would develop a third-person Call of Duty game set in the Vietnam War, attempting to leverage the team's experience on games like Dead Space to create a new kind of Call of Duty experience. That project was eventually killed as Sledgehammer was pulled in to help develop the original Modern Warfare 3 after Infinity Ward imploded.

Still, Sledgehammer tried to innovate again with its first solo title, Advanced Warfare. The game introduced exosuits, allowing players to jump, dash, and slide thanks to enhanced movement mechanics. It was a radical leap for Call of Duty, though fans largely rejected attempts to take the franchise into the future. Since then, Sledgehammer has played it fairly safe with two World War 2 games and a different game that also happened to be titled Modern Warfare 3, ironically enough.

Whether Sledgehammer Games can make something to excite fans again remains to be seen, but it'll be nice to have a non-MW or Black Ops game for the first time in more than five years.

articles.title: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy's New Netflix Movie Actually Isn't That Bad, It Turns Out
articles.summary: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy lead this semi-satirical and surprisingly melancholy Netflix movie.
articles.body:
Isn’t it nice when Netflix puts out a decent movie? Yes, the streaming juggernaut releases high quality efforts from auteurs like Scorsese and Del Toro , but then there’s the neverending parade of star-driven , empty calorie mediocrity; mostly paper thin comedy-action films with forgettable plots and vapid characters, whose only strengths come from the charisma of the actors playing them. At this point, Chris Evans is one of many likable actors who has made a few of these types of movies now, for multiple streamers, so it’s easy to assume Sacrifice will be another example. Yet lo and behold, this one actually feels like something with more commendable aspirations.

Evans plays movie star Mike Tyler here, attending a climate charity event on a Greek island while attempting a comeback after a public meltdown a year earlier. However, the event is interrupted by a cult-like group of radicals, led by Joan (Anya Taylor-Joy), who take everyone hostage at gunpoint.

And then… things actually go quite differently than you’d expect from a Netflix movie with this set-up and these stars. Because it’s incredibly easy to imagine the version of Sacrifice where Evans’ Mike must rise to the occasion, putting his movie star training into real world use… for halfhearted comedy-action hijinks.

But director and co-screenwriter Romain Gavras and his co-screenwriter, Will Arbery, have something more cerebral in mind. So while there are comedic moments to the film, especially early on, the story is actually focused on Mike as a man adrift – well aware of the performative nature of the rich, famous and powerful people he’s among – and what happens when he comes face to face with a group of genuine, albeit most certainly violent, activists.

Mike is one of three partygoers, along with billionaire Ben (Vincent Cassel) and performer Katie (Ambika Mod), to be chosen by Joan and her group for a supposed sacrifice in order to stop what they believe to be the imminent end of the world in just two days. This combination of a doomsday-prophet-on-a-mission story with an eat the rich hostage scenario ultimately feels somewhat like an enticing combination of this year’s Sam Rockwell-led Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die and another Anya Taylor-Joy movie, The Menu .

The journey that follows takes a lot of notable turns, as Mike begins to be drawn to the self-assured Joan and her absolute certainty in herself and what her mission is. And again, thankfully, Mike’s privileged movie star background isn’t used for just the jokey “get a load of this blowhard” approach it could be, but rather for something more introspective and thoughtful…

…Well, mostly. Because there are still some mannered, would-be pop-culture-skewing moments included, mostly via cutaways to some of the media attention the hostage story is getting or through Mike’s agent, Oliver (Sam Richardson). But as the story continues, these “wackier” scenes feel increasingly like a distracting, disconnected element that exists outside the central story.

Produced independently – Netflix picked it up following film festival screenings – Sacrifice has a strong visual approach thanks to music video veteran Gavras and cinematographer Matias Boucard. There are some great shots of the film’s island setting, nearby volcano included, and Gavras is among the directors who has realized that Taylor-Joy’s unique features, shot in a stark closeup (including straight to camera), make for a stirring cinematic image in their own right, particularly when the actress is playing a determined character such as Joan.

Sacrifice doesn’t quite accomplish all it’s setting out to do, and despite strong work from Evans and Taylor-Joy, the characters are more archetypes than richly detailed. But they work well for what they are and in their depiction of two very different people on this odd and unexpected journey together.

Those out of place, heightened comedy segments aside, the film is actually quite strange and melancholy in an inviting way, backed by an atmospheric score by Gener8ion and cool song choices like Leonard Cohen’s “Who By Fire” (meanwhile, Charli xcx pops up early on at the charity event, singing a tongue in cheek song about helping the environment).

Cassel has some strong moments as the arrogant Ben, while Yung Lean and Jade Croot both convey the right attitude as Joan’s likeminded siblings and partners. John Malkovich is a great casting get as Joan’s father (Malkovich and Taylor-Joy as father and daughter just seems right), though he feels underutilized. Salma Hayek Pinault has some fun moments early on as Ben’s wife, though the character feels somewhat forgotten about as the film progresses.

articles.title: The Mummy 4 Now Officially Titled The Mummy: Book of the Dead
articles.summary: The Mummy: Book of the Dead is the official title of the next movie in Brendan Fraser’s beloved action-adventure film franchise.
articles.body:
The Mummy: Book of the Dead is the official title of the next movie in Brendan Fraser’s beloved action-adventure film franchise.

Universal Pictures confirmed the news on Thursday, October 15, exactly one year out from its release date on October 15, 2027. While this date had already been revealed, Universal stated that it remains the same, with the film still on track to hit theaters this time next year.

Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz are set to return as Rick and Evie O’Connell, alongside other cast members including John Hannah, Michael Johnston, Numan Acar, Kevin J. O’Connor and Oded Fehr. We’ve already seen some of these characters back in action; Fehr shared a look at himself as Ardeth Bay on Instagram back in August, while recent photos taken from set showed Faser and Weisz in full costume reprising their adventures together.

The Mummy: Book of the Dead is being directed by Radio Silence’s Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett will direct the film, with David Coggeshall (The Family Plan, Orphan: First Kill) writing the screenplay. Mummy fans will be happy to hear that Sean Daneil is producing, given his long history with the franchise, having produced every single film in the series.

The new movie’s title certainly leaves ample room for speculation as to what its plot will be. Combined with Oded Fehr’s return as Ardeth Bay, it’s looking more likely than ever that Imhotep is back and wreaking havoc once more, bringing the series back to its roots.

For those who need a bit of a refresher on Mummy lore, the Book of the Dead is an ancient tome that contains spells capable of bringing the dead back to life and summoning the Warriors of the Book. It appeared in the very first Mummy movie and was last seen in The Scorpion King 3: Battle for Redemption.

Fehr’s involvement in this movie is also a big hint that things are returning to form; he was notably absent from 2008’s The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor, saying that without Imhotep as the big baddie, his character wouldn’t have any reason to appear. Given that the Book of the Dead is almost certainly involved in this movie, and Ardeth Bay is back in action, it’s possible that someone summons Imhotep back into the land of the living using the Book, bringing the gang back together again.

For now, nothing is certain. Most recently, Fehr joked that the third Mummy movie didn’t exist , saying at Comic-Con Holland: “It’s a very positive thing. The Mummy, The Mummy Returns — there wasn’t a third one — but the two movies were so… seriously, it was just fun.”

The Mummy: Book of the Dead hits theaters on October 15, 2027.

The acclaimed PC shooter, Squad , is coming to consoles — and PS5 players will be able to experience it very soon.

Developer Offworld Industries has announced that Squad will be making its way to Xbox Series X|S and PS5. PlayStation players will be able to give it a whirl later this month with a playable alpha, which will take place from October 16 - 25. The developer has promised an optimised experience for console with handpicked maps, a "bespoke polish for flawless performance," optional crossplay with other consoles, and new communication methods via a radial wheel that allows you to issue commands and pings. The game is expected to bring its 50v50 matches to the consoles, as well.

If you're interested in checking out the alpha on PS5, you can click here to sign up . As of right now, there's no release date for Squad's console version. The PC version of the game launched in 2020, and it has been one of the more beloved tactical shooters on Steam for some time. Before Wardogs ever came into the picture, Squad attempted to strike a balance between the milsim nature of Arma with the more fast-paced action of more mainstream shooters like Call of Duty or Battlefield.

It'll be interesting to see if Squad can beat Wardogs to consoles. Bulkhead has already announced that Wardogs will hit consoles in 2028 and recently told IGN that expects the game to also have a port on next-gen hardware, when it becomes available. The studio also revealed that it has been building Wardogs with Xbox Series S in mind, ensuring that not only will it be optimized for consoles, but also for lower-end PCs.

articles.title: Dell Just Released Its New 32" Alienware AW3226Q 4K Gaming Monitor With RGB Stripe Tandem OLED Tech
articles.summary: Now available for a surprisingly competitive price.
articles.body:
Dell just released a gaming monitor featuring one of the newest panel technologies at a surprisingly affordable price. The new-for-2026 32" Alienware AW3226Q gaming monitor is now available at Dell.com at a launch price of $699.99 with free shipping. This is a rare gaming monitor that combines a native 4K resolution with a gorgeous OLED panel, now made better with LG's new RGB Stripe Tandem OLED technology. If you're looking for an excellent 4K gaming monitor that you plan to also use as your daily workhorse, then the AW3226Q should be on your short list.

New Release: 32" Alienware AW3226Q 4K OLED Monitor

32" Alienware AW3226Q 4K RGB Stripe Tandem OLED Gaming Monitor

The Alienware AW3226Q has no lack of features that make it stand out from the crowd, but perhaps its most impressive technology is the RGB stripe tandem OLED panel. Tandem OLED stacks multiple OLED layers on top of each other instead of a single layer. Tandem OLED is better than other OLED panels because: 1) it's much brighter (the AW3226Q in particular has impressive 1,000 nits of peak brightness) and 2) it's less prone to burn-in.

The AW3226Q doubles down on this with new RGB stripe technology. Whereas traditional tandem OLEDs use white pixels, RGB stripe tandem OLED breaks the color down further into vertically aligned red, green, and blue pixels. This reduces color fringing and in turn significantly improves text clarity. It goes without saying that there are obvious benefits here for both gaming and productivity purposes alike.

With an impressive 3840 x 2160 (4K) resolution, this 32" monitor boasts a pixel density of 138ppi. OLED monitors are known for their extreme fast response time and perfect black levels, making them ideal for gaming. The AW3926QW ups the ante with its 165Hz refresh rate at 4K and support for AMD FreeSync Premium Pro and NVIDIA G-Sync compatibility. It has both DisplayPort 2.1 and HDMI 2.1 ports so you'll be able to connect it to just about any modern day graphics card.

Alienware also backs the monitor up with a 3 year warranty that covers OLED burn-in.

articles.title: RuneScape Reignited Canceled Less Than Two Weeks After Being Announced
articles.summary: Creative director Mod Ryan announced that RuneScape Reignited, a new game mode designed for both old and seasoned players to start fresh, has been canceled less than two weeks after it was first announced.
articles.body:
Creative director Mod Ryan announced that RuneScape Reignited, a new game mode designed for both old and seasoned players to start fresh, has been canceled less than two weeks after it was first announced.

The news was published on October 15 in the form of an official YouTube video and blog post, where Mod Ryan revealed that Jagex’s choice to cancel Reignited was in direct response to player feedback.

“We received a ton of different perspectives from all of you, and we truly appreciate everyone sharing their views. It is super important to us because the last time we didn't listen to player feedback, combat changed forever. And it has taken us over a decade to recover from that. Now I said on stage that we would not repeat the same mistakes of the past, and I truly stand by that. Considering this, we have made the decision to cancel Reignited,” the post reads.

RuneScape: Dragonwilds First Look Screenshots and Art

“It is clear that we missed the mark on this, and so we are not moving forward with it. Our goal is to see RuneScape grow again, with returning players coming back and new players joining, but never at the expense of our existing community.”

That being said, that doesn’t mean RuneScape is now without any exciting developments for new players who are looking to finally try it out for themselves; starting December 2, RuneScape will hold a 10-day free trial that will let new characters — or any character that, by that date, hasn’t been in membership since June 2 — access RuneScape Members worlds and content until December 12.

The team at Jagex are also releasing the Adventure Guide and the first part of the Remastered Journey, as well as a “host of other improvements” to the game. Its 2027 roadmap is still going strong, and Plugins are still scheduled to launch on Monday, October 19.

“There's tons of combat and skilling content throughout. We're bringing decade-old storylines to a close, with a return to a proper grandmaster quest. And we're reworking a core skill that is fundamental to the player experience: Agility. All of this while still continuing to deliver meaningful changes as part of the Road to Restoration,” Ryan said.

“...the future of RuneScape is still extremely bright. RuneScape will always be built for and defined by its community. So please keep letting us know when you feel we're getting it wrong and shout with that same energy when you think we're getting it right too,” he continued.

RuneCcape Reignited was revealed on October 3 during RuneFest 2026 . Essentially, it’s like WoW Forever , allowing both new and returning players to start off with a clean slate and experience the game as if everyone were playing it for the first time. However, a vocal portion of the game’s playerbase felt that this would fracture its community, arguing that it would be better for the devs to focus on ongoing updates and improvements, instead — and it seems like Jagex listened to their concerns.

It looks like players are extremely happy about this turn of events, if the top posts on the game's subreddit are anything to go by. "I’m glad to see Reignited is canceled, that does go a long way to rebuilding trust," one player wrote. "...We’re here because we love this game and we do want more people to join, because it’s no secret that our playerbase is small and does not grow much. We want new people, but we want them to join this game, not a parallel copy of this game."

"We said no to Hero Pass and they removed it, we said no to Reignited and they removed it, we b**ched and moaned about [microtransactions] they eventually removed [them]. This is the reason the game is almost three decades old with active players," another said.

RuneScape 4 was also announced at RuneFest. While we don’t know much about it yet, we do know that it’s designed to be a next-gen version of the celebrated MMO built on the Unreal Engine. No release date has yet been shared.

articles.title: NLCS Game 4 Discussion: Milwaukee Brewers (3-0) @ Los Angeles Dodgers (0-3)
articles.summary: Crew goes for the sweep in Los Angeles
articles.body:
After a sweep at the hands of the Dodgers in the 2025 NLCS, the Brewers are looking to reverse the sweep in 2026, as they have a 3-0 series lead heading into Thursday night's Game 4 at Dodger Stadium.

To get to this point, the Brewers have displayed a balanced (and surprisingly homer-heavy) attack from the offense while the pitching staff, anchored by the bullpen, has kept them in the game until the offense can put it away.

After a 2-1 win in Sunday's series opener, the Brewers won a back-and-forth affair in Game 2 by a final of 7-4, with five perfect innings from the bullpen putting an exclamation point on a 2-0 series lead. Last night was more of the same — after a leadoff homer by Jackson Chourio, the Brewers couldn't get to Blake Snell in the middle innings. Abner Uribe had a bit of a misstep in the bottom of the sixth, allowing a two-run double by Will Smith, but DL Hall shut down that rally before Jake Bauers and Garrett Mitchell retook the lead with a pair of homers in the seventh, as Milwaukee ultimately won 6-2.

Tonight, it'll be lefty Shane Drohan getting the ball for Milwaukee in his first career postseason appearance and first time on the mound since the regular season finale on September 27. For the year, Drohan went 7-5 with a 4.19 ERA, 3.73 FIP, and 125 strikeouts over 124 2/3 innings, splitting time between the rotation (19 starts) and bullpen (14 relief appearances). He made three appearances (one start) against the Dodgers this year, totaling 9 2/3 innings with six runs allowed (five earned) on six hits and five walks, striking out 12.

Drohan figures to be out there for one turn through the order, with Dustin May, Aaron Ashby, and the rest of the bullpen likely to take the bulk of the work.

Opposite Drohan is L.A.'s No. 4 starter (also their fourth All-Star starter), Tyler Glasnow. Glasnow, in his 11th MLB season, has dealt with injuries throughout his career, and 2026 was no exception. He made 13 regular season starts this year, going 5-2 with a 3.53 ERA, 2.74 FIP, and 98 strikeouts across 74 innings. He then went 4 2/3 innings in the NLDS last week against the Braves, allowing one run on one hit and five walks, striking out five in the Dodgers' series-clinching 4-1 victory.

Glasnow has made nine career regular season appearances (five starts) against the Brewers, going 0-3 with a 4.55 ERA and 37 strikeouts over 31 2/3 innings. He also pitched against them in last year's NLCS, going 5 2/3 innings with one run allowed and eight strikeouts in a no-decision.

Behind Drohan, Pat Murphy is rolling out another matchup-heavy lineup. Chourio is in his usual leadoff spot, followed by Brice Turang, William Contreras, and Bauers. Christian Yelich is back at DH after Andrew Vaughn got the start last night, with Garrett Mitchell batting sixth. Cooper Pratt, Sal Frelick, and David Hamilton round things out.

Los Angeles has moved Shohei Ohtani back into the leadoff spot after he batted sixth last night. He's followed by Mookie Betts, Freddie Freeman, and Will Smith. Kyle Tucker bats fifth and Teoscar Hernández bats sixth. The bottom third of the order features Miguel Rojas, Andy Pages, and Kiké Hernández.

First pitch is slated for just after 7:00 p.m. CT on FS1 and FOX One, as well as the Brewers Radio Network.

articles.title: Shohei Ohtani back at leadoff, Rojas and Kiké start in NLCS Game 4
articles.summary: The Dodgers are in an unfamiliar position entering Thursday, teetering on the brink of elimination after having dropped the first three games of the NLCS to...
articles.body:
The Dodgers are in an unfamiliar position entering Thursday, teetering on the brink of elimination after having dropped the first three games of the NLCS to the Milwaukee Brewers.

The Dodgers managed to get some production with runners in scoring position in Game 3 to take a 2-1 lead, only to have it short-lived with a pair of home runs against Blake Snell in the top of the seventh inning. The Dodgers once again are reshuffling things for Game 4, and the most prominent change was moving Shohei Ohtani back into his usual leadoff spot.

Ohtani showed some improvements at the plate on Wednesday, going 1-2 with a single and a hit-by-pitch. His flyout against left-hander Robert Gasser came off the bat at 90.3 miles per hour before roping a blistering single up the middle against DL Hall at 113.5 miles per hour, the hardest hit ball by a Dodger this postseason. The move comes as a surprise to Ohtani, as Dave Roberts didn't communicate with the two-way superstar about his change in the lineup, per David Vassegh of AM 570 .

Mookie Betts and Freddie Freeman continue to fill the top of the lineup, this time moving down to their no. 2 and no. 3 slots respectively. Betts has struggled at the leadoff position this postseason, slashing just .231/.355/.231 with zero extra-base hits and zero RBI. Freeman has lost himself at the plate since his heroics against his old team in the NLDS, slashing .091/.083/.091 with one RBI across 12 plate appearances.

Will Smith provided the lone bout of offense against Milwaukee in Game 3, and he goes from hitting seventh on Wednesday to moving up to the cleanup spot. Kyle Tucker remains in the middle of the lineup, hitting one slot down from Wednesday at fifth. Tucker has been one of the only consistent bats for the Dodgers this October, as after a nice showing against Atlanta, Tucker is hitting .250 with an .830 OPS. Teoscar Hernández falls down to the sixth in the lineup after two consecutive hitless games.

In what might be the final game of his big league career, Miguel Rojas gets the start at second base batting seventh. Rojas has posted the best offensive numbers for any Dodger over the past seven games, hitting .333 with a .929 OPS and a double over just seven plate appearances. Rojas once again gets the start against a left-hander— this time being Shane Drohan— over Max Muncy. Andy Pages slides down to the eight spot, and Kiké Hernández gets the start over Tommy Edman at the nine spot manning third base. Tyler Glasnow gets the ball looking to save the Dodgers' season for at least one more game.

articles.title: Mortal Kombat Creator Ed Boon Responds to Street Fighter Cast Saying They Want a Crossover Movie
articles.summary: Mortal Kombat co-creator Ed Boon has responded after the cast of the Street Fighter movie were vocally enthusiastic about the idea of a crossover film with Mortal Kombat, and it looks like he’s open to the possibility, too — as long as a game gets made first.
articles.body:
Mortal Kombat co-creator Ed Boon has responded after the cast of the Street Fighter movie were vocally enthusiastic about the idea of making a crossover film with Mortal Kombat, and it looks like he’s open to the possibility, too — as long as a game gets made first.

I got the chance to chat with the cast of the Street Fighter movie ahead of its October 16 release, and many of the actors involved told me they’re absolutely game for a crossover with the Mortal Kombat films. In fact, Andrew Schulz joked that this was the real goal of his infamous jab at the MK cast during the 2025 Game Awards.

“Hell yeah,” Andrew Koji, who plays Ryu, told me when asked about the possibility. “That’d be sick.” (He even brought up the idea of a Marvel vs Capcom movie, though that particular project is extremely unlikely to ever happen.)

“I want more Street Fighter,” Noah Centineo, who plays Ken, added. “If you bring an opportunity to us to be able to come back and reup these incredible characters, I’m down, and I know we’re all down. So if that’s Mortal Kombat, if that’s me kicking Thor in his face, you know?”

It wasn’t long before Ed Boon himself became aware of these comments, which he responded to in a post on Twitter/X. “Game first... then movie,” he wrote alongside a winky face emoticon.

While Boon is probably just trolling, this isn’t the first time he’s mentioned the idea of Street Fighter and Mortal Kombat colliding; in May 2026, he tweeted about wanting a Street Fighter guest character in a Mortal Kombat game, saying he was a “huge fan” of the series.

Game first... then movie. ;) — Ed Boon (@noobde) October 15, 2026

Given that Mortal Kombat is a fighting game franchise known for its wild and wacky crossovers, a Street Fighter collab certainly wouldn’t be a stretch for the folks at Netherrealm. Street Fighter has had its own share of crossover games over the years ( Street Fighter x Tekken , Project X Zone , Tatsunoko vs Capcom , to name a few), but the brutality and bloodiness of Mortal Kombat seems at odds with Street Fighter’s branding… and that’s exactly why Capcom rejected a proposal from Netherrealm when they were approached for a partnership some time ago.

“It's true that a proposal for a Street Fighter character in Mortal Kombat was rejected by Capcom,” former Street Fighter producer Yoshiniori Ono said in a 2019 interview . “But it wasn't me personally! There were many people at the company that felt that it wasn't a good fit for our characters. I actually met Ed [Boon] at the Brazil game show and spoke to him personally about it. So it's true — but I didn't make the decision!”

Now that Street Fighter is under new leadership that seems keen on crossovers and guest characters of all types , it’s possible that Capcom’s tune may have changed. They were enthusiastic about Yujiro Hanma joining Tekken 8 , for example, and even seemed open to the idea of collaborating with Baki again , which previously enjoyed a partnership with Street Fighter 6 in 2023 and 2024.

It’s also worth noting that, now that Paramount and Warner Bros have merged , Skydance owns the rights to the Mortal Kombat and Street Fighter films — so at least as far as red tape is concerned, there are far less obstacles standing in the way of these two worlds colliding on the big screen.

articles.title: Sega pulls Total War: Shogun 2 remaster from sale following disastrous launch

articles.body: Sega is removing Total War: Shogun 2 — Complete Edition from storefronts following a disastrous launch where users complained about issues like bugs and upscaling that appears to have been done by AI. Complete Edition, a remaster of the 2011 strategy game, launched on Tuesday, and it bundled the main game and all of its DLC with promised upgrades including “improved visuals,” “1440p and 4K UI scaling,” and modernized controls. It has an “Overwhelmingly Negative” rating on Steam, where it has already been pulled, and posts on Reddit showcase artwork that users believe AI messed up. [Media: “We’re aware that Total War: Shogun 2 – Complete Edition has fallen short of both your expectations and our own standards,” Sega and developer Creative Assembly wrote in a post. “We’ve seen your feedback, comments, and reviews. We agree that the current experience is not where it needs to be.” The two companies say they will “reinstate the original game,” and existing owners will “still be able to access” Complete Edition. Sega and Creative Assembly say that they are “working closely with our development partner to identify the causes of these problems, deliver improvements, and ensure Shogun 2 - Complete Edition meets the quality standards players expect from Total War.” A studio called Mataboo is also listed as a developer for the game on Steam, and Mataboo highlights its work on the game on its website.

articles.title: Steam can now show game achievements in separate ‘sets’
articles.summary: Valve is introducing a major new feature for Steam achievements called “achievement sets” that lets developers list different groups of achievements for a base game and DLCs.
articles.body: Valve is introducing a major new feature for Steam achievements called “achievement sets” that lets developers list different groups of achievements for a base game and DLCs. “In games that support sets, you still unlock achievements by playing the game as usual,” Valve says. “But when you browse what you have unlocked afterward, Steam will break the long list of game achievements into the developer-created sets, making it easier to see what you have completed and to find other related achievements you can unlock next.” Achievement sets have their own progress bars, and if you finish a set, you’ll get a “set complete” trophy that’s visible on your profile. Steam will support seasonal achievement sets that developers can archive, too. “We think there are a lot of fun ways games can take advantage of the temporary nature this can add, such as adding achievements to season-based games or enabling time-limited holiday achievements,” Valve says. [Image: Look below the progress bar — you can see the different sets there. A handful of games already support achievement sets, per Valve: > Against the Storm > Age of Wonders 4 > American Truck Simulator > Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 > Crusader Kings III > DREDGE > Euro Truck Simulator 2 > Forza Horizon 5 > Flock Around > He is Coming > LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight > Left 4 Dead 2 > Portal 2 > PowerWash Simulator > PowerWash Simulator 2 > Team Fortress 2 > Victoria 3 The company is also refreshing the Steam Achievements page to show “a summary of your overall progress, progress in each achievement set, and details on individual achievements.” [Image: The updated Steam achievements page. The new achievements features are available in the latest Steam client beta, Valve says.
